name: EWA Surface Splatting
aliases: Reduction from Volume to Surface Reconstruction Kernels
definition: A method where EWA volume splats reduce to surface splats suitable for high-quality iso-surface rendering by flattening the 3D Gaussian kernel along the volume gradient.
summary: EWA Surface Splatting is a high-quality point rendering algorithm that uses band-limited surface splats to efficiently suppress aliasing and guarantee hole-free reconstructions under arbitrary transformations.
